name: Lesser West gate
period: late 3rd century AD (c. 270–280): the stone wall as newly built, all gates open
conventions: u along the town wall, v out to the field (so the "n" drawing is the field front); metres; origin the anchor corner

rooms.name: Gateway
rooms.note: later narrowed to 2.13 m and the road raised 1.2–1.5 m (C&F 2016): not shown

openings.note: archway 3.55 m wide and 0.99 m deep in the outer face; an iron shoe for a gate pivot was found (C&F 2016, after St John Hope 1897). outer arch carried up as a crenellated parapet on the platform's field side (the parapet: comparison)
inner arch 3.62 m wide and 2.10 m deep towards the town (C&F 2016)

platforms.note: the wall-walk carried over the arch

note: wall 2.93 m thick here (C&F 2016); the GIS shows a gap of 5.35 m between the wall ends

drawings.caption: Field front: the archway in the wall's outer face
Section through the gateway: the outer arch and the deeper inner arch
